Composition.Note: Nominal composition: Al-0.3Zr-0.2Ce-0.2Cu (wt.%). Zr is supersaturated in α-Al matrix due to rapid cooling in AM.

Process_Text.original: The alloy was additively manufactured using laser powder-bed fusion (LPBF, EOS M290) at Beehive Industries. Powder feedstock was gas-atomized under nitrogen atmosphere and sieved into 20-63 μm size range. Mechanical coupons (115 mm long and 15 mm in diameter) were fabricated with their length aligned along the build direction under Ar atmosphere. No post-fabrication heat treatment for as-fabricated state.
Process_Text.simplified: LPBF additive manufacturing of Al-0.3Zr-0.2Ce-0.2Cu alloy using gas-atomized powder, no post-processing heat treatment.

Specimen_Geometry.Mechanical_Coupons: 115 mm long × 15 mm diameter, length aligned along BD

Equipment.Name: Bruker AXS 2nd gen. D2 Phaser XRD

Structure_Text.original: Elongated <001>Al and <101>Al grains aligned along BD spanning multiple melt pool widths. No fine grains observed. Submicron-sized (Ce,Cu)-rich precipitates distributed uniformly; thin region (~1 μm) above melt pool boundaries devoid of such precipitates. XRD reveals α-Al, Al8Cu4Ce, Al11Ce3, and Sn precipitates. High cooling rate completely suppressed primary Al3Zr formation. All Zr supersaturated in α-Al matrix.
Structure_Text.simplified: Coarse epitaxial α-Al grains elongated along BD with submicron (Ce,Cu)-rich intermetallic particles. Zr fully supersaturated in α-Al. No primary Al3Zr.

Secondary_Phases.Note: Metastable phase identified by XRD. Formed on solidification as submicron particles.
Identified by XRD as Sn precipitates. Adjacent to (Ce,Cu)-rich precipitates. STEM-EDS shows Sn-rich phase as part of agglomerated intermetallic particles.
Submicron-sized composite particles comprising Ce-Cu-Si phase, Sn-rich phase, and Fe-Ce phase. Scavenge Cu, Fe, Si impurities.

Grain_Size.Note: Described as elongated grains spanning multiple melt pool widths. Average grain diameter ~100 μm estimated for Hall-Petch calculation in Appendix B. Approximate cell size on surfaces perpendicular to BD ~1 μm used for resistivity estimation.
